versions.changelog:
- Initial release of douyin-video-downloader: batch download tool for Douyin account videos.
- Input Douyin ID to auto-fetch all works, parse no-watermark download links, and support one-click download to local storage.
- Features include: pagination, date range filtering, Markdown/JSON output, rate limiting, error/failure tracking, and multi-account mode.
- API integration with redfox.hk for both work list retrieval and direct video download link parsing.
- Comprehensive CLI documentation, agent integration guidelines, and detailed user prompts for robust and user-friendly operation.
